$comment: add-feature-flag-seam: the single registry of ReleaseTwin's own feature flags. Canonical source for web/ (imported directly, like hosted/plans.json), hosted/ and the CLI (embedded resource). See docs/feature-flags.md. NOT LaunchDarkly's product-adapter config — this gates ReleaseTwin itself.

flags.description: Inert end-to-end proof that the feature-flag seam is wired on every surface. Gates nothing user-visible; safe to flip.

commercial-readiness-gaps: master switch for outbound run-failure notifications (Slack / webhook). Off by default — the ingest path skips enqueue and the dispatcher Lambda drops every message while this is false. Independent of the per-org Team entitlement, which still gates configuration and delivery.
